name: ready-items-report
title: Ready Items Report
summary: Create an exact cost report from a supplied inventory and reporting month.
description: A file-only workflow that validates a new attached inventory, retains ready items, calculates exact decimal line costs and a total, and creates a Markdown report for an explicitly supplied month. Includes its own standard-library helper. Requires an already available native Python 3.10+ interpreter; no Creator, source recording, external connection or installer.
